🇳🇱 What surprised you the most about life in the Netherlands?
The canals, cycling culture, beautiful women, unique Dutch houses, tulip fields, incredible water engineering — or the fact that so much of the country lies at or below sea level?
👇 Tell us your answer in the comments!
And if you could spend one month living anywhere in the Netherlands, which city would you choose — Amsterdam, Rotterdam, Utrecht, or somewhere else?
Thanks for watching and exploring the Netherlands with Amazing Discoveries Top US! 🌷🚲🌊
